title: El encuentro
goal: Read how first contact with the Taíno turned from peaceful exchange to forced labor and demographic collapse within a generation, and meet the friar who later condemned it in print.

items: Describe how the first encounter is recorded in Columbus's own diaries.
Explain what the encomienda was officially, and what it was in practice.
Explain what caused the sharpest population decline among the Taíno.
Describe who Bartolomé de las Casas was and what he did.
Use connectors like 'al principio / sin embargo' and 'mientras' to order and contrast events.
